subject: c-cont
title: C.CONT.------PHY.U.P.
description: Chart on book p. 125 (T(AF)M-29). C-CONT (composite continuance) is the subject; PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) is the partner. POL-P (political policies) is typed above the main line with no dot and is read as the label of the junction where the ALT-F line leaves it, so the main line runs from the subject to POL-P and from POL-P to PHY-U-P. From POL-P: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: INFO-DE (information degrees). From INFO-DE: BIA (bi-aitional) and ALT-ACT (alternative activism). From BIA: PROG-SIGN (progressional significance). From ALT-ACT: PROG-EXT-F (progressional extended functionalism). From PROG-EXT-F: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From AF-DY: AFN (affinity negation).
